scientific_integrity: Constructive path-counting proof and standalone finite-field checks; independent mathematical audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Set-theoretic image and finite-field cardinality at size p+3 only; no root multiplicities or higher sizes. Small-field numerical specializations and the p=2 case were known previously; priority of the uniform theorem is not independently established.
title: A uniform first-nonsurjective power-image theorem for unitriangular groups in every prime characteristic
